opening.text: I'm a veteran who came back from a deployment to Afghanistan 2 years ago. For the past 2 months, I've been having trouble concentrating at work and I feel tired all the time. I've lost interest in things I used to enjoy, like my dance classes. I also wake up early and can't fall back to sleep. My spouse has noticed that I'm speaking more slowly than usual and that my appetite is down.
